cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Basically Finished
cards.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The budget report is finished: a title page with space underneath. You remember my lesson about letting people contribute.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The board meets in ten minutes. They need your figures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're thinking about the audience. This is the participation edition; they can put their figures straight in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The chair wants your recommendation, not a worksheet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're finally distinguishing discussion from decision. I'll write 'Approve' under the title. Finished decision edition; no one has to fill anything in.
